name: Openframe
description: The whole corner treatment turned inside out: an octagon with a square hole cut through it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(69.1% 3.8%, 96.2% 30.9%, 96.2% 69.1%, 69.1% 96.2%, 30.9% 96.2%, 3.8% 69.1%, 3.8% 30.9%, 30.9% 3.8%); clip-path: polygon(69.1% 3.8%, 96.2% 30.9%, 96.2% 69.1%, 69.1% 96.2%, 30.9% 96.2%, 3.8% 69.1%, 3.8% 30.9%, 30.9% 3.8%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%, 34.0% 34.0%, 34.0% 66.0%, 66.0% 66.0%, 66.0% 34.0%, 34.0% 34.0%); clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%, 34.0% 34.0%, 34.0% 66.0%, 66.0% 66.0%, 66.0% 34.0%, 34.0% 34.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
